title: Audit Python operator meanings
description: This exercise probes how in and len behave across several Python collection types.

steps.description: probe runs a supplied expression and prints either its result or the raised exception.
The first probes apply in to a list, string, and dictionary.

steps.question: What does 1 in {'a': 1} test in this dictionary?
steps.answer: It tests dictionary keys, so the page states that this expression is False.

steps.description: The TODO identifies the three meanings of in: element, substring, and key, then asks you to evaluate that inconsistency.
The second loop applies len to a string, list, dictionary, and tuple through probe.
The remaining TODOs ask you to add a separate operator audit and assess the resulting trade across the four criteria.
